name: API call types to a settled status
looks: A two-line claim stacks in above a dark rounded code panel. Inside the panel a short function call types on character by character with a blinking cursor, then a hairline rule appears and a dot-plus-word status line fades in beneath it as the payoff.
build: List-stack-reveal for the claim line; terminal-type-on for the code panel (steady per-character reveal, blinking ::after cursor), then the status line (coloured dot + word) fades/slides up 4-6px after a short pause once typing completes.
sound: A tick per stacked line, a light mechanical key tick per character while typing, then a single confirm tone on the status line.
prompt: State who the product serves as a two-line claim, then prove it with a real function call typing on in a dark code panel, finishing on a short confirmation status line below a hairline rule. Keep the call and its result true to what the product actually does, not a generic placeholder.
